title: Construction of the affine module tensor functors and comparisons
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Write $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, let $\rho:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal A$ be the structure map, and let $r_0:f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$, $t_0=f^{-1}\rho$, and $e:f^{-1}\mathcal A\to\mathcal O_U$ be the structure map, inverse-image map, and ring inverse-image/direct-image counit. Write $R$ for pushforward as an $\mathcal A$-module, and $S$ for restriction to $\mathcal O_X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Tensor pullback and change of rings are those of [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and the adjunction is the canonical one of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There exist a pushout algebra $B=\mathcal O_U\otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_X}f^{-1}\mathcal A$, its maps $b,t$ and the multiplication counit $\epsilon$ with $b\epsilon=1$ and $t\epsilon=e$, an extension-of-scalars functor $P$ along $t$, and a natural isomorphism $\kappa$ from its underlying module functor to $Sf^*$. The comparison on the pullback unit is the sheafification of $1\otimes\eta(g)$. There is an extension-of-scalars functor $H$ along $\epsilon$, a natural tensor-unit map $\gamma:Sf^*\to H$ taking $p$ to the sheafification of $1\otimes p$, and $H$ preserves quasi-coherence [pqf-def-coherent]. There are natural maps $\alpha:RH\to 1$ and $\beta:1\to HR$ such that $\gamma_{RF}\alpha_F$ is the pullback counit and $S\beta_G$ is adjoint to $\gamma_G$. Both functors act on morphisms by the corresponding changes of rings, conjugated by their stated object equalities. No invertibility of $\alpha$ or $\beta$ is asserted.

theorem affine_module_tensor_construction [IsAffineHom f] :
    ∃ (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u})
      (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B) (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf),
      IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t ∧ b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf ∧ t ≫ ε = e₀ ∧
      ∃ (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f),
        (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)) ⊗ₜ[
                  (IA).obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V),
                  (t.hom.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g))) ∧
        ∃ (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ U.Modules)
          (hobj : ∀ G, H.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))
          (γ : S ⋙ tensorPullback f ⟶ H),
          (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
            H.map a = eqToHom (hobj G) ≫
              SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G) (P.map a) ≫
              eqToHom (hobj G').symm) ∧
          (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ)
              (p : (P.obj G).val.obj W),
            ((eqToHom (hobj G)).val.app W)
              ((γ.app G).val.app W ((κ.hom.app G).val.app W p)) =
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 U.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
                (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))).app W
                  ((1 : U.sheaf.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W, (ε.hom.app W).hom] p)) ∧
          (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
            G.IsQuasicoherent → (H.obj G).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
          ∃ (α : R ⋙ H ⟶ 𝟭 U.Modules) (β : 𝟭 (SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) ⟶ H ⋙ R),
            (∀ F : U.Modules, γ.app ((R).obj F) ≫ α.app F = (adj₀).counit.app F) ∧
            (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
              (S).map (β.app G) = ((adj₀).homEquiv ((S).obj G) (H.obj G)) (γ.app G))
